Setup

Install md-publisher-cli globally with npm, then create a Publication: a directory of mdpub files, numbered so their filenames sort into the chapter order you want.

Run the generate command against that directory, naming the Build Targets you want. Output is written to a dist folder next to where you ran the command.

See Introduction for the big picture, or continue to Advanced Topics.
